items.title: Mrs. Arnold Metoyer Interview, 1960-10-19
items.q: You don't have anything of him when he was with Barnum and Bailey, huh? No, no. Well he was with them five years.

ctx.x: Yeah, some people use those on the music rack, they clip it. Quite a few people do that.

You see, evidently, when he, after he'd learned to read music was when he began playing with these bands. But there was a big band, all the way through the band. The band, well he didn't have a band. You don't have anything of him when he was with Barnum and Bailey, huh? No, no. Well he was with them five years. He traveled with them all that time. Five years, yeah. He traveled all that time. And that's what I wanted to tell you. My mother told me he used to play for the races. Oh yeah, he played in the band, but…
I like to have it at the fairground. I still have it at the fairground. He'd be the one that blew the bugle. Yes.
